verdict.rationale: Wise's own docs explicitly claim businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts to their customers, backed by supporting account/currency/card issuance and FDIC passthrough features. However, this is entirely first-party marketing/docs with no independent case study confirming a developer actually embedding Wise accounts for end customers, and community reports show real operational risk (a Wise Business account being fully blocked over category mismatch, and account details changing with no notice) that could undermine trust in offering these as a foundation for customer-facing banking. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the embedded accounts flow, and resolution of the compliance/account-stability concerns raised by users.
